subject: Nanotechnology
title: Nanowire Solar Cells
description: Learn Nanowire Solar Cells in one minute.

hook.text: A forest of vertical nanowires traps light like a black hole — absorbing more sunlight than a flat surface.

buildup.text: Light bounces between nanowires, getting multiple absorption chances — anti-reflection is built into the geometry.

discovery.text: Each nanowire is a radial p-n junction — carriers travel short distances to the junction, reducing recombination.

twist.text: Surface recombination on the huge nanowire surface area fights against the short-diffusion advantage.

climax.text: InP nanowire solar cells reached 17.8% efficiency — proving nanowire geometry can compete with planar designs.

punchline.text: A forest of nano pillars traps light and converts it all.

quiz.question: How do nanowire solar cells improve light absorption?
options: The wires emit their own light to supplement sunlight
Light bounces between vertical wires, getting multiple absorption chances
They reflect light back to the sun to warm it further
